slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: The move we get asked about most

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Google to Microsoft 365 has its own quirks, and they are worth knowing before you start rather than after. Google Docs, Sheets and Slides are not Office files. They convert on the way across, and anything with heavy formatting or a script behind it needs checking rather than assuming. Gmail labels are not folders either. A message can carry three labels at once, a folder structure cannot hold that idea, so decisions have to be made about what the mailbox looks like afterwards.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Shared Drives map onto SharePoint and Teams, which is usually an improvement, but it is a genuine restructure rather than a copy and paste. Calendar resources such as meeting rooms need rebuilding.

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: Any app that people sign into with their Google account has to be pointed at Microsoft instead, and that includes the ones nobody mentioned in the kick off meeting.

slots.label: Paragraph 7
slots.default: Ixia Clinical came across from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 with ten users and more than a terabyte of email and files, without disruption to clinical work.
